company: Department of Aerospace Science and Technology - Politecnico di Milano
text: On 10-11 September, #DAER - Department of Aerospace Science and Technology - Politecnico di Milano , in collaboration with Distretto Rotary 2041 , hosted “SPAZIO alle opportunità - SPACE for Opportunities”: two days bringing together students, researchers and industry representatives to explore emerging technologies, applications and professional opportunities in the space sector. The event was opened by Mara Tanelli , Rector’s Delegate for Diversity and Inclusion at Politecnico di Milano, and Massimiliano Papa , representing Rotary Distretto 2041. Michèle Lavagna , Professor at DAER, introduced the opportunities and challenges of a rapidly evolving space ecosystem. The first day focused on the impact of space technologies on society, with Giovanna Venuti , Associate Professor at the Dipartimento di Ingegneria Civile e Ambientale - Politecnico di Milano ( #DICA ), discussing Earth observation and satellite data, and Lorenzo Luini , Associate Professor at the Dipartimento di Elettronica, Informazione e Bioingegneria - Politecnico di Milano ( #DEIB ), addressing navigation, telecommunications and connectivity. The programme then explored the #SpaceEconomy and the new frontiers of robotic and human #SpaceExploration - from in-orbit services and future orbital infrastructure to space debris management, advanced materials and the use of lunar resources. Read the article: https://lnkd.in/eHC684px #Polimi #AerospacePolimi

title: Joby Aviation
text: A small plane landed on the tarmac at Salt Lake City Airport on Wednesday. Its pilot didn’t, though. They were 700 miles away, controlling the aircraft from a facility in in Concord, California. Dozens of people watched from the Utah Department of Transportation ’s hangar as Joby Aviation ’s J208 aircraft touched down in Utah’s capitol. Although a safety pilot was onboard as a passenger in the aircraft to meet requirements from the Federal Aviation Administration , that pilot never input any controls himself, according to the aviation company. These planes have already been used in military operations — along with the required onboard safety pilot — but Bonny Simi , Joby’s president of operations, said they will likely move to the “next stage” with the FAA — flying without an onboard pilot — sometime next year. It’s unclear when they could become commercially available in Utah. Read the story to learn more. By Jordan Miller https://lnkd.in/gFpQ8fTr

title: MathWorks
text: I came across a MathWorks post this week, brilliantly narrated by Monica Wang , about REGENT Craft's Viceroy Seaglider, and I have not stopped thinking about it since. The Viceroy is an all-electric maritime vehicle that flies just above the water's surface, inspired by how birds like pelicans glide low over the ocean using ground effect to conserve energy. Turning that biological trick into a certified, human-rated vehicle is an extraordinarily hard engineering problem. The craft has to float on its hull like a boat at the dock, rise onto hydrofoils for stability and manoeuvrability as it picks up speed, then transition into full ground-effect flight within one wingspan of the water's surface at speeds up to 180 mph, and every one of those transitions has to be safe, repeatable, and predictable. Here is the part that genuinely excites me. Before this craft ever touched real water for crewed testing, REGENT engineers built the flight control stack using Model-Based Design in #MATLAB and #Simulink , modelling the vehicle and its full operating environment virtually. That means they could test and iterate on edge cases, failure conditions, and operating extremes long before putting a single physical prototype at risk. This is precisely the value of a digital twin. You can fail thousands of times safely before you fail expensively once in the real world. It connects directly to my own Master's thesis at the Universität Rostock , on large-scale data collection for fingerprinting-based indoor #localization , specifically in highly dynamic hospital environments where radio-reflecting equipment is constantly moving. Building a real-world dataset by hand in an environment that changes by the hour is close to impossible. A digital twin makes it tractable, and the resulting dataset is intended to train a neural network through unsupervised learning, powering downstream AI-based location prediction once deployed in the real world. Massive respect to the REGENT team and to CEO Billy Thalheimer for the engineering ambition here, and to MathWorks for building the tools making this kind of virtual-first development possible. #DigitalTwin #MATLAB #Simulink #Engineering #Innovation #localization

title: Shuhrat Negmatov
text: Strengthening AI Cooperation in Dushanbe During my visit to Area AI in Dushanbe, I had a productive meeting with representatives of Tajikistan’s rapidly developing AI ecosystem, including Masur Nazari, Deputy Chairman of the AI Council under the Ministry of Industry and New Technologies of Tajikistan, and Bonu Boboeva, Director of zehnlab.ai . Area AI 1.0, launched in 2026, is a Dushanbe-based hub connecting technology companies, startups, researchers, and investors to develop and commercialize AI solutions. Area AI is a project seeking to establish the world's first AI freezone — a platform connecting frontier R&D, talent development, green compute and value-added AI exports - from Tajikistan to the world. https://the-area.ai/ Our discussion focused on strengthening cooperation between AICA and Area AI, as well as developing closer engagement with Tajikistan’s AI Council and the wider innovation community. We also discussed all aspects of organizing the AICA Al-Khwarizmi Award ceremony as a permanent part of AI CONF, held annually at the end of October, creating a regional platform to recognize outstanding AI companies, startups, researchers, and innovators from across Central Asia. With initiatives such as Area AI, Soro LLM, and the growing AI CONF platform, Tajikistan is demonstrating strong ambitions in artificial intelligence. Closer cooperation among our regional AI ecosystems can help connect talent, technology, and investment while strengthening Central Asia’s collective position in the global AI landscape. I look forward to turning our discussions into practical cooperation. #AICA #AreaAI #AIConf2026 #ArtificialIntelligence #Tajikistan #CentralAsia #Innovation #AICAwards
author: Shuhrat Negmatov

title: Аида Гайнутдинова
text: За годы в HR я видела тысячи резюме. Сегодня в фокусе одно - моё. Кажется, пришло время узнать, кто хантит хантера 👀 . . . За последние годы я помогла десяткам людей сделать следующий карьерный шаг. Нанимала специалистов и руководителей, собирала команды, растила рекрутеров, выстраивала HR-процессы и старалась делать так, чтобы за всеми этими процессами никогда не терялись люди. А теперь очередь дошла до меня. Мой самый неожиданный hiring-проект этой осени найти новую команду для самой себя. За плечами путь от Recruiter до HRD, управление командой до 21 человека и HR-функцией в компании 180+ сотрудников. Мой основной опыт iGaming / High-Risk / IT. Recruitment, адаптация и offboarding, аналитика, performance review, корпоративная культура, бенефиты, внутренние коммуникации, развитие команды я люблю HR именно за то, что здесь невозможно заниматься только чем-то одним. Сейчас рассматриваю роли: HRD / Head of HR / People Partner / HR Business Partner / Head of Recruitment / Recruitment Team Lead. 📍 Белград | Remote И, пожалуй, самое главное. Этот пост должен попасть всего к одному человеку тому, кто сейчас ищет меня в свою команду. Если это вы буду рада познакомиться. А если среди ваших знакомых есть тот самый человек буду благодарна за репост или интро. 🤍 Тг: @Ulikuz #OpenToWork #HR #HRD #Recruitment #PeoplePartner #iGaming
